planting: BLOCKED pending admitted current-cover and road/safety/BOB exclusions

grid.anchor: AOI upper-left; matches accepted native Base_DTM grid
grid.pixel_rule: center for SIOSE IDs; all_touched for conservative building candidates

semantics.presence: Three overlapping bands: 1=source class present; 0=no return of that class, not proven absence; 255=no accepted samples
semantics.review_flags: bit1 invalid/negative height; bit2 relief>10m; bit4 source building overlap; 255 unknown; not complete safety exclusions
semantics.height: Existing unknown heights remain unknown; class presence does not repair normalization
semantics.character: Low may represent grass/low shrubs; medium/high do not identify species or individual tree positions
semantics.audit: Overlap counts are not additive; height_review_partition is disjoint

human_visual_acceptance.scope: Owner visually accepts green preview vegetation character; pink may be shrubs as art interpretation
human_visual_acceptance.limits: Does not validate normalized height, species, road safety, production graph or complete 2A
